run.name: Service Properties Trust
run.title: CP-OS host session (SVC)
run.summary: Service Properties Trust is highly leveraged and thinly covered, but 2026 asset sales and equity cut debt by USD 852.5 million. Refinancing the revolver that expires on June 29, 2027, and tenant concentration, decide the credit. Launched through CP-OS as of 2026-11-05 on the retained context.

revenue.basis: Total revenues, as the CP-1 table prints it.

leverage.basis: Total debt / EBITDA. Principal debt of 4,652,322 thousand over derived LTM core EBITDA of 475,642 thousand; unrestricted cash of 40,118 thousand (restricted cash of 22,374 thousand excluded). Derived as FY2025 plus nine months 2026 less nine months 2025; includes earnings of hotels sold during the period.

coverage.basis: EBITDA / cash interest. Core EBITDA of 475,642 thousand over derived LTM cash interest of 336,491 thousand. Cash interest excludes accretion on the zero coupon 2027 secured notes, which is non-cash until maturity, and is gross of interest income. Coupons are semi-annual so interim periods are lumpy.

cash.basis: Cash. Unrestricted cash at September 30, 2026; revolver undrawn at 650 at September 30 and November 2, 2026; variable funding note repaid and terminated in September 2026. The revolver matures June 29, 2027, within twelve months, with two six-month extension options subject to a fee and conditions.

cashflow.basis: Net cash provided by operating activities, as the CP-1 table prints it.

gaps: Host session: an agent answered every module from the pinned filings and CP-5 is its own review. No independent review has been made. Treat the analysis as candidate.
CP-2 main limitation: The company reports no EBITDA, the leverage figures use our own proxy that includes sold hotels, and revolver covenant headroom is not reported.
CP-1 main limitation: The company reports no EBITDA, and the credit agreement ratios and headroom are not supplied. Core EBITDA is our own definition and includes sold hotels.
